name: Bones of Grakkarond
summary: Across central Silithus, Grakkarond's bones lie beneath the sun. The bronze dragon fell in the ancient War of the Shifting Sands, and the Anubisath keep his remains sacred.

sections.title: A Monument of the Shifting Sands
sections.body: Grakkarond's skull and ribcage lie across the dunes of central Silithus. A thousand years ago, he fell in the War of the Shifting Sands. In that great clash, Ossirian the Unscarred struck him down. Ossirian was an Anubisath warrior, empowered by the dark powers of the city-kingdom. The Anubisath leave the bones where Grakkarond fell, a sacred mark of their might against the dragonflights.

faq.answer: These are the bones of Grakkarond, a great bronze dragon of the Bronze Dragonflight. A thousand years ago, he fell against the insectoid forces of Ahn'Qiraj in the War of the Shifting Sands.
Ossirian the Unscarred slew Grakkarond. An Anubisath warrior, he won great renown and dark blessings from Ahn'Qiraj's masters for his victory over the bronze wyrm.

faq.q: Why do the Anubisath revere this place?
faq.answer: The Anubisath revere the skeleton as a reminder of their decisive victory over a mighty dragonflight. It marks their strength against those who came to seal them away.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you can look to these bones and remember the War of the Shifting Sands. Your people and the four dragonflights fought side by side against the qiraji onslaught.
